verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for an accounting SaaS, but the pack has no evidence for it. The only API reference is a crawl note saying a GraphQL API lives at developer.waveapps.com; that portal returned 403, so none of its coverage could be verified. The marketing pages document no API, CLI or webhook surface, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all returned 404.
